description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; free trial: add "trial": true or use try_free). [Web and domain checks] CORS check. Will a browser on a given origin be allowed to call this URL: sends a CORS preflight (OPTIONS) and a GET with Origin, reports Access-Control-Allow-Origin / Credentials / Methods / Headers / Max-Age, Vary: Origin, and flags arbitrary-origin reflection, wildcard with credentials and null origin. Cached 5 min. ~0.3-2 s.

trial.description: Optional. true = free if a trial call is left (3 per IP per UTC day), else the payment terms.

url.description: API or page URL to test, e.g. https://example.com/

name: cors_check

_trial.description: Present when the call was a free trial call.

title: CORS check (preflight + allowed origins) ($0.002/call)
